pages.title: Nash Equilibrium
pages.text: $(thing)Nash Equilibrium$()$(br2)A set of choices where nobody does better by changing alone. Nash proved every game has one, if chance is allowed.

$(thing)Insight$(): 100$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Games and Strategy.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Rational Field.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Two firms sell the same thing; its price is A − B·(all they make), and each pays c a unit. Write how much Q each makes when neither can earn more by changing alone.
